citation.quote: MFG-1003 - Machined steel housing: USD 81.50 per unit.
MFG-1002 - Hydraulic valve block: USD 260.75 per unit.

Commencing 1 January 2025 and annually thereafter, Unit Prices shall be revised in line with the annual CPI-U inflation rate published for the prior calendar year, subject to a minimum increase of one and one-half percent (1.5%) and a maximum increase of four percent (4%).

With effect from 1 February 2025, the Unit Price for MFG-1002 (Hydraulic valve block) in Schedule A shall be USD 295.50 per unit. Price adjustments under the Agreement continue to apply to the amended Unit Price on subsequent anniversaries.
